# Momentum

![Momentum](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/momentum.png)

+5% Heads for every Heads in a row this level.

- **Rarity:** Rare
- **Heads chance:** 35%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 6 points

## Tails
Nothing

- **Starts in the deck of:** none
